defect: Reliability: the dashboard role (web app and Copilot) silently used the server real date instead of the RoofOps business date
found: 2026-10-04, while re-running the full suite for AC-06: test/copilot-tools.test.ts:35 failed on both engines once the real date passed PRJ-2026-0011 planned finish (2026-10-01)
root_cause: app_today() was a plain SQL function reading app_settings.business_date_override as the caller; roofops_dashboard had a column grant on app_settings, but RLS is enabled with no policy, so it saw no row and fell back to the real Brisbane date

fix.rule: app_today() is SECURITY DEFINER (fixed search_path): set date -> that date; missing or empty -> real Brisbane date; anything else -> error, never another date. Dashboard column grant on app_settings revoked.
